_comment: Merged into the project's .claude/settings.json permissions.allow by init --ui. Navigation, observation and ordinary interaction with the app under test, named one by one: a wildcard (mcp__playwright__*) would also allow browser_evaluate and browser_run_code_unsafe (arbitrary JavaScript in the page), browser_file_upload (sends a local file — a project .env included — to whatever page is open) and browser_network_request, which stay on the default ask.
